items.title: MIRACLE-3 (NCT06593548): trial-in-progress, clinical results pending
items.sourceLevel: Official registry JSON and official publisher-indexed ESMO GI 2025 trial-in-progress abstract; no clinical results posted.
items.reason: Protocol-only, planned 36 (33 evaluable), not observed enrollment or efficacy. Do not promote to outcome evidence. Annals calls AK112 ivonescimab, while registry currently names Ivosidenib/Lvosidenib; retain explicit unresolved discrepancy. Current registry status UNKNOWN, last update 2024-09-19; planned completion is not proof of study completion.
